title: Senior OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap to leave for new venture

content_html:
Reuters

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 11:41 AM CDT 1 min read

Aug 11 (Reuters) - Senior OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap said on Tuesday he would leave the company to ‌start a new venture, as the ChatGPT maker ‌gears up to go public amid growing AI demand.

"Over the last ​few months, I've been focused on the next horizon and what would stand in the way of mission success. I believe there are a few important new things the world ‌will need to ⁠get right as we enter this next period," Lightcap said in a post on X.

In ⁠response to Lightcap's post, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he was "excited to work together on what's next."

Lightcap moved in ​April from ​his role as OpenAI's chief ​operating officer to a ‌role focused on leading special projects. He previously worked with Altman at venture capital firm Y Combinator and joined OpenAI in 2018.

OpenAI said that in recent months, Lightcap's responsibilities had already shifted away from the day-to-day management of ‌larger organizations, so the company ​does not expect his departure to ​impact teams.

Lightcap's departure follows ​a similar announcement from Fidji Simo, OpenAI's ‌CEO of AGI deployment, who ​said in July ​she would step down from her full-time role and pivot to a part-time advisory position at the ​ChatGPT maker, following ‌an extended medical leave for a neuroimmune condition.

(Reporting ​by Juby Babu in Mexico City; Editing by ​Tasim Zahid and Shreya Biswas)

content_html_zh:
路透社

2026 年 8 月 11 日星期二上午 11:41 CDT 阅读时间 1 分钟

路透 8 月 11 日 - OpenAI 高级执行官 Brad Lightcap 周二表示，随着人工智能需求不断增长，ChatGPT 制造商正准备上市，他将离开公司去创办一家新公司。

“在过去的几个月里，我一直专注于下一个视野以及阻碍任务成功的因素。 我相信，当我们进入下一个时期时，世界需要一些重要的新事物来解决，”Lightcap 在 X 上的一篇帖子中说道。

OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 在回应 Lightcap 的帖子时表示，他“很高兴能够就下一步的工作进行合作”。

Lightcap 于 4 月从 OpenAI 首席运营官的职位调任为专注于领导特殊项目的职位。 他此前曾与 Altman 一起在风险投资公司 Y Combinator 工作，并于 2018 年加入 OpenAI。

OpenAI 表示，近几个月来，Lightcap 的职责已经从大型组织的日常管理转移，因此该公司​预计他的离职不会影响团队。

Lightcap 离职之前，OpenAI 负责 AGI 部署的首席执行官 Fidji Simo 也发布了类似的声明，她于 7 月表示，在因神经免疫性疾病延长病假后，她将辞去全职职务，转而担任 ChatGPT 制造商的兼职顾问职位。

（Juby Babu 墨西哥城报道；Tasim Zahid 和 Shreya Biswas 编辑）
